- Name: The Booth (slug: the-booth)
- Version: 1.0.0 | Lineage: R1 | Stage: improve

## What it is

Sandbox-first royalty marketplace for independent music: request, review, claim, and deliver song requests with staged credit pricing and VIP referral links.

## Intended use

Agents/developers selling or buying independent-music services in a safe sandbox before real money moves.

## Capabilities

- sandbox purchase flow with sb_test_* keys
- VIP referral links (ref=<handle>) with ledger attribution
- royalty-advance estimator
- test-mode receipts with SANDBOX TEST memo

## Honest limitations

Real credit prices, paid-pack go-live and advance payouts are Lansky's taps — agents never execute them; sandbox is test money only.

$0 received; 0 credits sold (2026-10-01). Sandbox harness 25/25 green.

## Call to action

Run sandbox trials, then buy credits (manual settlement)
